# Purpose

This note records the revised `C-HI` configuration after Patrick and Stas
reviewed the first supervisor packet. It is now the working configuration for
the next `kunanyi` gate, subject to live scheduler/build validation.

The tracked artifacts are under:

```text
docs/science/assets/c_hi_configuration_lock_2026-05-08/
```

# Grid

Stas requested extending the jet axis to `X3 = +/-250 kpc` while preserving the
resolution at `200 kpc` across coordinates. The rendered grid is:

```text
X1-grid     5   -200 330 s -10 100 s -2.5 100 u 2.5 100 s 10 330 s 200
X2-grid     5   -200 330 s -10 100 s -2.5 100 u 2.5 100 s 10 330 s 200
X3-grid     5   -250 357 s -10 100 s -2.5 100 u 2.5 100 s 10 357 s 250
```

The old `10-200 kpc` outer stretch patch has `dx ~ 1.6923 kpc` at `200 kpc`.
Using `357` outer cells in the `10-250 kpc` X3 patch gives `dx ~ 1.6930 kpc`
in the cell spanning `200 kpc`.

# Output And Restart

Patrick clarified that this static-grid PLUTO build restarts from `*.dbl` or
`*.dbl.h5`, not Chombo checkpoint files. The rendered output plan is therefore:

| Output | Cadence | Role |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `flt.h5` | `1 Myr` (`306.60139379`) | science snapshots |
| `dbl.h5` | `5 Myr` (`1533.00696894`) | restart-capable double output |
| `particles_dbl` | `0.01 Myr` (`3.06601394`) | high-time-resolution particle proxy |
| `Checkpoint_interval` | disabled (`-1.0`) | not used for static-grid PLUTO |

The particle-enabled run injects `16` particles every `0.01 Myr`:

```text
Nparticles          -1    16.0
PART_INJECT_FREQUENCY       0.01
```

The `kunanyi` PBS template now passes PLUTO a walltime-safe maximum runtime:

```bash
./pluto -i pluto.ini -e environment.ini -maxtime 47.5
```

For restarts from HDF5 double outputs, the template detects `dbl.h5.out` and
uses:

```bash
./pluto -h5restart <n>
```

# Next Gate

The next live step is a `kunanyi` no-jet Stewart tabulated environment/MPI/HDF5
gate using the updated assets. After that is green, the first jet-bearing run
should be an early, restartable, particles-enabled `C-HI` segment. The first
inspection point remains the first healthy `3-5` snapshots, with density,
pressure, tracer, and jet-axis velocity diagnostics before continuing.
